heading: Focus Analytics
text: Worklog Studio's analytics engine identifies peak productivity hours, flow states, and distraction patterns, helping users optimize their daily schedule.

heading: Seamless Integrations
text: Worklog Studio syncs automatically with GitHub (commits and PRs) and Linear (issues and workspace tasks) today. Google Calendar and Notion integrations are planned.

heading: Frictionless Tracking
text: Start logging a deep work session with a single keystroke or click. No complex forms or project setup required — the interface stays out of the way until it's needed.

heading: Value Proposition
text: Worklog Studio is a minimal, distraction-free desktop time logger for professionals, developers, and creators who prioritize deep work and flow states. It avoids the high-friction, form-heavy UI of traditional time trackers.

heading: Target Audience
text: Worklog Studio is built for engineers, designers, and founders who want to understand where their time actually goes without breaking their concentration to log it.

heading: Current Roadmap
text: The macOS app is released. Advanced analytics is in progress. Windows support and team collaboration features are planned for future releases.
